title: Rally Day
brief: The Kingmaker's biggest rally is today. Go in as security, swap his speech, and get Zainab's camera into the VIP tent.
standout: His own words, out of his own mouth, live.

say.speaker: The rally ground
lines: Zainab: I need my camera in that tent and his real speech on that stand.
Amaka: Which one is the real speech?
Zainab: The one his treasurer wrote for the donors. It is on the phone you took.

objectives.sub: Security walks. It does not run.

objectives.text: Swap the speech on the stand
Get Zainab's camera into the VIP tent

sayDone.speaker: Yarns, an hour later
lines: @lagosgist: The Kingmaker just read out who is paying him. On his own stage.
@oshojaboy: 'To our friends at Crestline, who keep the levy money safe.' HE SAID IT.
Zainab: His polls are gone. And Big Bar now knows your names.
